obernants.observation_scope: builtins/mod registers files/io; io calls display::format_disp and exp_str; fileio uses table inference/date/name adapters and column-major Mat; main creates Interp with selected fs and selected tests/fs CLI helper observes exit/stdout/stderr/journal/files. sprintf column-major traversal and display row layout are different adapters; JSON orientation/nonfinite loss prevents identity roundtrip. Octave calls lexical filter is not parser validation, and VMM digest helper evidence is not scenario correctness.
obernants.operator: Interp failure excludes CLI export_dir but permits journal and previous imports; VFS error with requested status excludes throw for mkdir/rmdir/move/copy. J::Num/numeric-class nonfinite conversion excludes the original numeric literal; logical NaN instead converts to true under the nonzero predicate. No runtime scenario guarantee follows from helper checks.
